_readme: Venue quality ratings used to badge each publication.
journals: canonical journal name -> best SJR quartile (highest quartile across all Scopus categories, most recent year on scimagojr.com, checked 2026-07).
journal_aliases: raw 'journal = {...}' string in pub.tex -> canonical name above.
conferences: ordered list of rules; the first rule whose 'match' string appears in the booktitle (or in the whole bibtex entry) wins.
ggs = GGS Rating from the GII-GRIN-SCIE Conference Rating (CINI), edition 2021.
ggs values 'wip' (Work in Progress) / 'none' (not in the CINI list) produce no badge.
kind='workshop' produces a neutral 'workshop' badge instead of a rating.
Badges are shown only for: journals Q1/Q2, conferences A++/A+/A/A-, and workshops.
